The author is providing background information about something that Rezin did on this same military campaign. The author related in [14:22](../14/22.md) how Azariah, the grandfather of Ahaz, recaptured Elath and brought it back under the control of the kingdom of Judah. The renewed loss of this city shows how the kingdom declined because of the idolatry of Ahaz. In your translation, introduce this information in a way that would be natural in your own language and culture.

nt: Ahaz is using each of the terms **servant** and **son** to offer to become a vassal of Tiglath-Pileser if he will help him. See how you translated the term “son” in [8:9](../08/09.md) and use a comparable expression for addressing someone respectfully in your language. You could also use plain language. Alternate translation: [I will obey you and I will be personally loyal to you]
